title: Cops destroy P38M in contraband cigarettes in Bacolod City

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The police destroyed around P38.78 million worth of suspected illicit and untaxed cigarettes at the Bacolod City Sanitary Landfill in Barangay Felisa on Wednesday afternoon, Nov. 11. The Bacolod City Police Office (BCPO) led by PCol. Eugene N. Rebadomia partnered with concerned government agencies to perform the joint inspection and proper disposal of around 377 boxes of contraband. According to consolidated investigation reports, the recovered and voluntarily surrendered products were valued at exactly P38,781,500.00.
